limitations: Restricted to zero phase shift. The sharp algebraic law excludes strong-stable histories when the delay is positive. The result does not classify supercritical recurrent dynamics. The 2020 Ikeda normal-form analysis and older general scalar-delay stability theory leave residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
provenance: Exact Lyapunov-Krasovskii dissipation identity and characteristic-spectrum/center-manifold analysis for the zero-phase autonomous Ikeda delay equation.
record_title: Ikeda critical delay stability and sharp relaxation law
